name: Name
author: Author
authorHelp: The author is one of the accounts, and owns the jigsaw.
gridInfo: Grid {{ grid }} px: {{ columns }} × {{ rows }} pieces (worked out from the number of pieces).
difficultyTitle: How close a piece must be dropped to its place to click into it: the easier, the farther away it can be
staleBefore: The size changed since the picture was cut.
noPicture: This jigsaw has no picture. You can save the changes without one (the size and the pieces then stay as they are), or choose a picture (jpeg, png or webp) to give it one and change those too.
choosePicture: Choose the picture the jigsaw is made from (jpeg, png or webp).
findCutFirst: Find the cut of the picture first.
couldNotReadUsers: Could not read the accounts: reload the page.
couldNotOpen: Could not open the jigsaw to edit: go back and try again.
couldNotSave: Could not save the changes: nobody may have started playing it in the meantime. Check the picture and try again.
couldNotMake: Could not make the jigsaw. Nothing was saved: check the picture and try again.
visibilityHelp: Public: in the lists of everyone. Private: only its owner and its players see it. Hidden: only in the list of your own jigsaws, not on the front page or in any other list.
timedHelp: A clock counts how long each round takes.
descriptionPlaceholder: A place, a day, a memory…
languageHelp: The language the name and the description are written in. It starts as your language.
classify: Let the AI set categories, name and description
classifying: The AI looks at the picture…
classifyHelp: The picture is sent to OpenAI to be looked at. The name, the description and the categories are replaced.
classifyFailed: The AI could not do it: try again.
languageAi: Changing it has the AI write them again in the new language.
motiveHelp: How hard the picture itself is to put together: the fewer distinct details, the harder. The AI sets it too.
saveAnalyseHelp: The picture is sent to OpenAI to set the categories, the motive difficulty, the name and the description.
kindPictureHelp: People choose the number of pieces and the difficulty when they start a round.
kindJigsawHelp: You choose the number of pieces and the difficulty now.
limitCount: {{ count }} of {{ max }} pictures used. A verified account has no limit.
limitFull: You have {{ max }} pictures, the most an account that is not verified can have. Verify your account, or delete a picture.
